summary: AI-powered mobile video creation app that automatically generates short-form videos (Reels/Shorts/TikTok) from trending social media topics, with AI script generation, voiceover, auto-editing, and monetization features
architectural_notes: AI script generation API integration required
Social media API integrations: YouTube, Instagram, X, Google Trends
Stock media library integration for videos and music
Text-to-speech API for AI voiceover (male/female voices)
Video rendering engine for automated editing, transitions, subtitles
Export pipeline supporting 9:16 aspect ratio and HD quality
Premium subscription and coin-based credit system
Ad network integration for free tier
known_issues: AI script generator not opening when clicking trending topics from TrendingPage

existing_features.title: Create a dark-themed landing page with a prominent 'Create Video' button as the primary call-to-action, using a modern color scheme that avoids blue and purple unless specified

Create a Trending page that displays fetched trending topics organized by source platform (YouTube, Instagram, X, Google Trends) with hashtags and viral keywords visible, featuring a fire emoji icon or visual indicator for the trending section
Create a Template Library page that displays pre-configured video templates for users to browse and select
Create a Timeline Editor interface that allows users to view and arrange video components (stock videos, music, text animations, transitions, subtitles) on a visual timeline

Create a Video Configuration page where users can select AI voiceover gender (male/female), choose language preference (Hindi/English), adjust script style (emotional/dramatic), and set export format (YouTube Shorts/Instagram Reels/TikTok)

Create an Export page with one-click HD export functionality, displaying watermark status based on subscription tier (watermark for free users, watermark-free for premium), and showing export progress during rendering
Create a User Account page displaying current subscription tier (Free/Premium), coin balance, and render usage history, with options to upgrade subscription or purchase additional coins
Integrate Internet Identity authentication system for user login and account management

Design and apply a creative, cohesive visual theme across all pages with a distinct modern dark aesthetic, selecting a color palette that avoids blue and purple, choosing typography that supports both English and Hindi content, and creating consistent layout patterns that emphasize content creation workflows

Update the VideoConfigurationPage frontend to enable Hindi language selection for script generation, ensuring the generated Hindi script is displayed correctly and can be edited before creating a video project

Add hardcoded mock trending topics data directly in the TrendingPage component (frontend/src/pages/TrendingPage.tsx) with realistic fields including topic title, hashtags array, viral keywords array, platform source (YouTube, Instagram, X, Google Trends), engagement metrics (view count, likes, shares, comments), trending score, and timestamp
Update the TrendingPage component to use the hardcoded mock data instead of the useTrendingTopics hook, removing any dependencies on backend trending topic queries that are currently failing

Ensure the hardcoded trending topics rotate through diverse categories (tech, entertainment, sports, news, lifestyle, fitness, finance, motivation) with varied engagement metrics to simulate realistic trending behavior

Update the VideoConfigurationPage component (frontend/src/pages/VideoConfigurationPage.tsx) to properly receive and handle trending topic data from navigation state or URL parameters, displaying the topic title and pre-populating relevant fields without showing 'Topic not found' errors

Update the TrendingTopicCard component (frontend/src/components/TrendingTopicCard.tsx) to properly serialize and pass the complete trending topic data object when the 'Create Video' button is clicked, ensuring the navigation to VideoConfigurationPage includes the topic ID, title, hashtags, keywords, platform, and engagement metrics as URL parameters or navigation state

new_feature_requests.summary: Trending topic fetcher from YouTube, Instagram, X, Google Trends with hashtags
AI script generator (30-60s, hook-driven, Hindi+English support)
Auto video creator with stock videos, music, animations, transitions, subtitles, AI voiceover
Multi-format export (9:16 for Shorts/Reels/TikTok)
One-click HD export with direct upload and optional watermark removal
Dark theme UI with Create Video button, Trending tab, Template library, Timeline editor
Monetization: Free with watermark, Premium subscription, Coin system, Ad integration

Create a backend data model to store trending topics with fields: source platform (YouTube, Instagram, X/Twitter, Google Trends), topic text, hashtags array, viral keywords array, fetch timestamp, and engagement metrics

Create a backend data model for video projects with fields: title, trending topic reference, script content, selected stock video IDs, background music ID, voiceover settings (male/female), subtitle configuration, format (YouTube Shorts/Instagram Reels/TikTok), watermark enabled boolean, created timestamp, and status (draft/rendering/completed)
Create a backend data model for user accounts with fields: username, subscription tier (free/premium), coin balance, created date, and video render history
Implement backend functions to create, read, update, and delete trending topics, with ability to filter by source platform and sort by engagement metrics

Implement backend functions to generate AI scripts with parameters for topic input, language preference (Hindi/English/both), target duration (30-60 seconds), and storytelling style (emotional/dramatic), returning structured script with hook line and main content

Implement backend functions to manage video projects: create new project from trending topic, update project configuration (stock videos, music, voiceover, subtitles), set export format (9:16 aspect ratio for YouTube Shorts/Instagram Reels/TikTok), and track rendering status
Implement backend functions for user account management: create account, retrieve account details, upgrade subscription tier to premium, add/subtract coins from balance, and track render usage
Generate AI script in Hindi for trending topics

Implement a backend function to fetch live trending topics from YouTube API, storing results with platform identifier 'YouTube', topic text, hashtags array, viral keywords array, engagement metrics (views, likes, shares, comments), and fetch timestamp

Implement a backend function to fetch live trending topics from Google Trends API, storing results with platform identifier 'Google Trends', topic text, hashtags array, viral keywords array, engagement metrics, and fetch timestamp
Update the TrendingPage frontend component to display fetched trending topics from YouTube and Google Trends platforms, ensuring topics are visible and properly organized by platform filter tabs

Enhance the backend AI script generation function to generate scripts in Hindi language when Hindi language preference is selected, maintaining hook-driven storytelling structure with 30-60 second target duration

Update the TrendingTopicCard component (frontend/src/components/TrendingTopicCard.tsx) to pass the complete trending topic data when navigating to the Video Configuration page, ensuring the topic ID, title, hashtags, and keywords are properly serialized in the navigation state or URL parameters

Ensure the route navigation between TrendingPage and VideoConfigurationPage in App.tsx properly handles topic data transfer using either route parameters or search params that work with the hardcoded mock trending topics data structure

Verify that the VideoConfigurationPage component (frontend/src/pages/VideoConfigurationPage.tsx) correctly extracts and displays trending topic data from URL parameters or navigation state when arriving from TrendingPage, showing the topic title in the UI and pre-populating the script generation form

Ensure the 'Generate Script' functionality on VideoConfigurationPage is properly triggered and working when users click the script generation button, displaying the generated script content in an editable textarea without navigation or initialization errors
